SUMMARY: hairstyle a short sculpted quiff with tapered sides and a smooth nape; costume silhouette a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar; design idea The coat's rigid front panels separate along a staggered seam that exposes their ribbed cross-sections like split bamboo.; face a sharp, striking, intense look; fair skin; round face; smaller, narrower eyes than usual anime proportion — soft droopy eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; sharp angled brows; aquiline nose; thin long lips; teal eyes; dark berry lipstick.; expression a composed, self-assured look, subtle and relaxed.

A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Du Yu of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the strategist who conquered Wu 'like splitting bamboo'.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a sharp, striking, intense look; fair skin; round face; smaller, narrower eyes than usual anime proportion — soft droopy eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; sharp angled brows; aquiline nose; thin long lips; teal eyes; dark berry lipstick.
Body and hair: curvy build; a short sculpted quiff with tapered sides and a smooth nape; cobalt-blue hair.
Expression: a composed, self-assured look, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: scholarly campaigns, an annotated Spring and Autumn Annals, decisive momentum.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as a tactical electronic-warfare mecha frame — slender plating, a sensor-array head unit, holographic map projectors and floating drone bits. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: The coat's rigid front panels separate along a staggered seam that exposes their ribbed cross-sections like split bamboo.
Colours: deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white, with small accents of deep plum purple and silver (the Sima Jin). Faction frame: navy-blue and black lacquer heavy plating with cold steel-silver edges, angular command fins, a disciplined symmetrical frame, cold blue glow lines.
Signature item: a split bamboo stalk, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders, and bare upper thighs between the hip armor and thigh-high leg plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Wei Federation in orbit: a navy-black orbital fortress and capital-ship fleet above a cold blue planet, starfields and a distant sun, hard white floodlights on armored hulls.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: The split stalk rests across her nearer palm, with her other hand relaxed below her waist.
Setting detail: A sunlit orbital logistics concourse, framed by tall graphitic service gantries and brushed metal floor lanes.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
